'''''Blade's Edge''''' was a heavily modified [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was operated by the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After Leeachos incurred the ire of the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] and went on the run, he took shelter in the [[NovaCORE kelerium processing plant]] in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], docking ''Blade's Edge'' inside an exhaust vent in an abandoned annex of the factory. A group of Pyke-affiliated agents eventually tracked Leeachos to the plant, and he attempted to flee aboard the Headhunter.
